from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def lattice_lines(axis):
        n = h if axis == 0 else w
        m = w if axis == 0 else h
        density = []
        for i in range(n):
            count = sum((grid[i][j] if axis == 0 else grid[j][i]) == 9
                        for j in range(m))
            density.append(count / m)

        best = None
        for period in range(2, min(15, n - 1) + 1):
            for phase in range(period):
                selected = list(range(phase, n, period))
                other = [i for i in range(n) if i % period != phase]
                if len(selected) < 3 or not other:
                    continue
                a = sum(density[i] for i in selected) / len(selected)
                b = sum(density[i] for i in other) / len(other)
                score = abs(a - b)
                if best is None or score > best[0] + 1e-12:
                    best = (score, period, phase)

        _, period, phase = best
        return list(range(phase, n, period))

    rows = lattice_lines(0)
    cols = lattice_lines(1)
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]

    out = []
    for r in range(len(nodes) - 1):
        row = []
        for c in range(len(nodes[0]) - 1):
            counts = Counter((nodes[r][c], nodes[r][c + 1],
                              nodes[r + 1][c], nodes[r + 1][c + 1]))
            color, count = counts.most_common(1)[0]
            row.append(color if count >= 3 else 9)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):

    # The separators are the nearly uniform rows and columns of color 9.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(9) / w > 0.8]
    cols = [c for c in range(w)

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    background_colors = set(x for x, _ in freq.most_common(2))
    background = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]

    marked = [
        (r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
        if grid[r][c] not in background_colors
    ]
    rows = sorted({r for r, c in marked})
    cols = sorted({c for r, c in marked})

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]
            ]
            color = corners[0]
            if color not in background_colors and all(x == color for x in corners):
                line.append(color)
            else:
                line.append(background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
